title: Massive model expansion: Nova, Qwen, Grok, and Wan2.2
summary:
A massive shipping day bringing Amazon Nova, Alibaba Qwen, and xAI Grok models to the API, alongside headless CLI auth and hourly Pollen refills.

We wired up Amazon Nova (text, image, video), Alibaba Qwen (with native CJK and multi-image editing), and xAI's Grok (now with reasoning, official image/video models, and a 2M context window). We also dropped in Wan2.2 for free-tier 5-second video generation, and fixed some routing and secret bugs that temporarily ghosted the new models.

Flower and Nectar tiers now get their Pollen refilled hourly instead of daily, smoothing out burst limits for heavy tinkerers. We also overhauled the automated Spore-to-Seed upgrades: the script now evaluates a full year of GitHub commit history, runs 6x faster throughout the day, and won't fail on API rate limits. Plus, Grok and gptimage-large text inputs are now cheaper.

Implemented the RFC 8628 Device Authorization Grant. You can now securely authenticate CLI tools and headless scripts without writing weird browser workarounds (and we fixed the scope inheritance). We also shipped a much cleaner model monitor UI with 24h/7d health aggregations, added BYOP attribution tracking, and scrubbed some lingering marketing copy from the Play page to keep things feeling like a hackerspace.

highlights.title: Amazon Nova arrives
highlights.text: The Nova model family (Pro, Canvas, and Reel) is now wired up for text, image, and video generation. We also enabled image-to-image variation support for Canvas.

highlights.title: Grok learns to reason
highlights.text: Added official xAI integration for `grok-imagine` and `grok-video-pro`, plus upgraded text models featuring `grok-reasoning` with a casual 2M token context window.

highlights.title: Qwen image models
highlights.text: Added Alibaba's `qwen-image-plus` and `qwen-image-edit-plus`. Native CJK text rendering and multi-image editing are now on the menu.

highlights.title: Fast, free, and moving
highlights.text: Added `wan-fast` for free 5-second video generation. We also defaulted `audio=true` across the video API, so supported models will just generate sound automatically.

highlights.title: Headless in the hive
highlights.text: Implemented RFC 8628 Device Authorization Grant. You can now securely authenticate terminal tools and headless scripts without complex browser workarounds.

highlights.title: Free the MIDI
highlights.text: We split the `midijourney` text model into a free base version (Claude Haiku) and a large variant (Claude Opus) for complex compositions.

highlights.title: Showcase additions
highlights.text: Phicasso Chat (browser-native privacy) and AI MIDI Generator (text-to-multitrack) have joined the community showcase. [Try them](https://hello.pollinations.ai)
